title: Photograph a page you cannot read
summary: Use character recognition on a photo, then verify each recognised word in the dictionary.
attribution: Original content authored for this project.

blocks.body: Recognition from a photo is a way to turn an unreadable page into a list of candidates. Steady the paper, fill the frame with one short block of text at a time, and use good light, since a menu in dim warm light produces nonsense. Treat the output as a starting point: pick out the words that look plausible and look each one up, because recognition tools merge and drop characters freely. On a device where the images never leave it, this is also the calmest way to study a sign or a train ticket after you get home.
